name: web_search
description: Search public web via unofficial best-effort DuckDuckGo. Query up to 256 characters.

name: read_page
description: Read a public HTTPS HTML/text/Markdown page or follow a selected link. No JavaScript.

name: inspect_image
description: Request an unverified model response about a selected public JPEG/PNG; may fail. Extra model token charges apply.

name: profile_information
description: Find app-known devices and saved connections across all profiles, refreshing device lists once per invocation. Optional query matches part of a device name/label, connection name or profile name (case/NFC insensitive); profile_id selects an exact profile. Empty arguments browse. Results are whole records: follow next_offset with the same query/profile_id when needed. Give a concise answer with all suitable variants, distinguished by profile/device/connection, not the whole catalogue or only the first match. Several matches are not a failure; ask for a choice only if needed for a subsequent action. Use exact profile.id and connection.id for saved targets. Disclose incomplete/stale sources; zero known matches is not absence from unknown sources. App state is not service readiness. Private information goes to the configured model.

name: ssh_command
description: Run one noninteractive command on a saved SSH connection over a ready tunnel. Use profile_information IDs. FULL SSH ACCESS within account rights; command/output may contain secrets and go to the model. No retries.
